purpose: Part 2/4 of verified dynamic 100-record item effect batch 011; together these files contain exactly 100 self-contained reviewed records.

items/preserving-jar.name: Preserving Jar
items/preserving-jar.effectSummary: Organic material sealed inside the 2-gallon jar does not rot, age, or wilt. The effect preserves but does not revive or sustain living creatures, and previously decayed material remains in its current state.

items/keoghtoms-ointment.name: Keoghtom's Ointment
items/keoghtoms-ointment.effectSummary: Each jar contains five applications. An application neutralizes poison, removes disease, or heals 1d8+5 hit points depending on how it is used.

items/dust-of-the-zephyr.name: Dust of the Zephyr
items/dust-of-the-zephyr.effectSummary: Released into a breeze, the dust creates 1d4+1 Small air elementals after 1d4+1 rounds. They are uncontrolled and attack the nearest creatures until destroyed or banished, though other magic can later control them.

items/mask-of-sweet-air.name: Mask of Sweet Air
items/mask-of-sweet-air.effectSummary: The wearer can breathe safely in smoke, dust, and fumes, is immune to airborne stench attacks and airborne poisons, and benefits continuously from water breathing.

items/orc-double-axe-567.name: Orc Double Axe
items/orc-double-axe-567.effectSummary: The orc double axe is a double weapon usable with normal two-weapon fighting penalties. If wielded in one hand, only one end can be used during that round.

items/pipe-of-grief.name: Pipe of Grief
items/pipe-of-grief.effectSummary: Once per day, lighting the pipe creates a stationary 5-foot-radius cloud for 3d8 minutes. Creatures in the cloud other than the user must make Will DC 17 or take -4 morale on attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks for 10 rounds.

items/sleeping-spike.name: Sleeping Spike
items/sleeping-spike.effectSummary: Planting the spike is a standard action; one round later it becomes invisible. The first creature to come within 10 feet triggers a 20-foot-radius sleep effect affecting creatures of 10 HD or fewer (Will DC 17 negates), after which the spike is destroyed.

items/shackles-silence-431.name: Shackles of Silence
items/shackles-silence-431.effectSummary: The shackles surround the restrained creature with silence sized to contain it. If the creature escapes without opening the shackles, the silence ends and the shackles emit an audible alarm for 1 round; escape and break DCs are 28.

items/xvims-green-eyed-gauntlet.name: Xvim's Green-Eyed Gauntlet
items/xvims-green-eyed-gauntlet.effectSummary: The wearer gains darkvision 60 feet. Each of the two gems can produce light once per day, and the gauntlet can cast phantasmal killer once before that power is permanently expended; its other powers remain.

items/easy-travel-31.name: Easy Travel
items/easy-travel-31.effectSummary: While wearing the armor, a medium load is treated as light for load-based Dexterity, check-penalty, and speed effects, though armor-based speed penalties still apply. The wearer can also walk 10 hours per day before forced-march Constitution checks begin.

items/furnace-of-flames.name: Furnace of Flames
items/furnace-of-flames.effectSummary: A dwarf using the forge to craft magic items may satisfy any spell prerequisite with the fire descriptor, using character level as caster level. The forge does not replace other prerequisites, minimum caster level, or gp/XP costs.

items/camouflage-paint-322.name: Camouflage Paint
items/camouflage-paint-322.effectSummary: Applying the paint is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity and grants +5 circumstance on Hide checks while stationary for 2 hours. Each jar contains five applications.

items/healers-balm-348.name: Healer's Balm
items/healers-balm-348.effectSummary: For 1 minute after application, the balm grants +1 alchemical on Heal checks made to aid the treated creature. Applying it is a standard action that provokes, but it can be incorporated into first aid, wound treatment, or poison treatment.

items/pincer-staff-581.name: Pincer staff
items/pincer-staff-581.effectSummary: The two-handed staff has 10-foot reach and cannot attack adjacent foes. On a hit against a creature within one size category, the wielder can start a grapple as a free action without provoking; a maintained hold deals the staff's normal damage each round.

items/collar-of-command.name: Collar of Command
items/collar-of-command.effectSummary: An animal wearing the collar is controlled by the owner as though under dominate animal and obeys silent mental commands. Under skirmish or mass-battle rules it also loses the Difficult special ability.

items/shadow-cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
items/shadow-cloak.effectSummary: The cloak grants +1 deflection AC. Three times per day when attacked, the wearer can either gain concealment for 1 round or teleport up to 10 feet to a clearly visible space.

items/thurible-of-retribution.name: Thurible of Retribution
items/thurible-of-retribution.effectSummary: When lit, the thurible produces prayer and grants spell-like effects: three/day command, doom, or inflict light wounds; one/day spiritual weapon or searing light; one/week inflict critical wounds or mass inflict light wounds; one/month geas/quest.

items/dragonskull-talisman.name: Dragonskull Talisman
items/dragonskull-talisman.effectSummary: On command, the wearer and up to two creatures touching the talisman gain hide from undead for 30 minutes; each protected creature must remain in contact with the talisman for the protection to persist.

items/phoenix-helm.name: Phoenix Helm
items/phoenix-helm.effectSummary: The wearer gains low-light vision and can use feather fall, flame arrow, fly, resist energy, and speak with animals (birds only) each once per day.

items/redeemed-demon-armor-467.name: Redeemed Demon Armor
items/redeemed-demon-armor-467.effectSummary: The redeemed armor remains +4 full plate and allows +1 claw attacks dealing 1d10 damage; a struck target must save Will DC 16 against sword of conscience. A nongood wearer gains one negative level.

items/ring-solar-wings-424.name: Ring of Solar Wings
items/ring-solar-wings-424.effectSummary: Wearing the ring creates white wings and grants fly speed 150 feet with good maneuverability. Removing it in flight causes feather fall; a wearer who already has wings can use the ring's faster flight speed instead of growing new wings.

items/pariapt-sullen-sea-229.name: Periapt of the Sullen Sea
items/pariapt-sullen-sea-229.effectSummary: The wearer can hold their breath for up to 12 hours before Constitution checks are required. Twice per day, sacrificing a prepared spell or spell slot of 4th level or higher activates freedom of movement using the higher of the wearer's caster level or the item's.

items/mask-mastery-183.name: Mask of mastery
items/mask-mastery-183.effectSummary: The mask grants +5 competence on Intimidate checks. Once per day it can issue a command effect with Will DC 20 that is not language-dependent, though the target must be able to hear the wearer.

items/slime-pot.name: Slime Pot
items/slime-pot.effectSummary: If filled with water and decaying organic matter, the pot grows a patch of green slime within 24 hours. Dumping it out is a standard action that places the slime, but the owner has no special control over or immunity to it.

items/rod-metal-and-mineral-detection-52.name: Rod of Metal and Mineral Detection
items/rod-metal-and-mineral-detection-52.effectSummary: As a full-round action, the rod points toward the largest nearby mass of metal within 30 feet, or toward a chosen metal/mineral and its approximate quantity. If multiple chosen deposits are present, it points to the largest first.
